content: Unified file explorer table stakes: folder tree + breadcrumbs, grid/list toggle, sort, search across folders, breadcrumb nav, toolbar primary Upload; per-file preview/details/properties side panel; operations upload/download/create folder/rename/move/copy/delete; multi-select context menu; metadata/version panel. Advanced: drag-drop upload, resumable chunked uploads, per-file progress, permission-aware actions (hide unavailable), ZIP folder download, tabs/split view. Three-panel layout (tree | list | details) is common. Search respects permission scope.
